about.en: GUA is the token of SUPERFORTUNE, an app incubated by Manta Labs that combines AI with Chinese metaphysics such as Bazi and I Ching to produce fortune readings and crypto-market commentary. GUA unlocks premium features, buys in-app charms and funds buyback burns; it is a BNB Smart Chain BEP-20 token at 0xa5c8E1513B6A08334B479fE4D71F1253259469Be with a 1,000,000,000 total supply.
